answer_1.quote: We asked non-expert evaluators to assess the humanlikeness (operationalized as how believably human an evaluator finds a text) of text generated by current NLG models (GPT2 and GPT3) to test what current human evaluation practices can reveal about the models' quality...
answer_1.outputs: Generated text stories, news articles, and recipes

answer_4.quote: We used Amazon Mechanical Turk (AMT) to collect the text evaluations with non-expert evaluators, commonly used in NLG evaluations...
answer_4.guideline: Evaluators rated text on a 4-point scale for humanlikeness: 1. Definitely human-written, 2. Possibly human-written, 3. Possibly machine-generated, 4. Definitely machine-generated, and provided explanations for their ratings.
